question: Which remaining MXC child outcomes are required before this secure-contained-node epic is complete, and which should be descoped or moved outside this repository?
rationale: The unresolved work spans core containment, Entra identity, A365 governance, WinUI configuration, and ClawHub packaging, so repository evidence cannot choose the permanent product and security boundary.

options.title: Keep the current scope
options.body: Continue using the epic as the dependency tracker until every open child definition of done is implemented or explicitly rejected.

options.title: Narrow the definition
options.body: Remove or relocate selected identity, registry, UI, or ClawHub outcomes and document the reduced completion criteria.

options.title: Split the program
options.body: Create separate containment and enterprise-governance epics while preserving explicit dependency links between them.

recommendation.title: Keep the current scope
recommendation.body: Continue using the epic as the dependency tracker until every open child definition of done is implemented or explicitly rejected.

likelyOwner.reason: She authored and coordinates the epic and its product child issues, making her the clearest available owner for scope calibration.
